name: cover-title
text: Operating Visibility and Control for the Company
textPreview: Operating Visibility and Control for the Company

text:
Open by positioning the session as a management discussion, not a technical demo.
Say: Today we will start with the ERP concept, then focus on how AlAfkar ERP supports the company with Catering as the main operating story.
Set expectation: We will not show every button. We will show how the system improves control, visibility, and accountability.
